AstroTool
HU EN

Every night of yours, in one calm workspace.

AstroTool is a Mac app for astrophotographers. It scans your existing library, helps you plan the next clear night, and measures what you've captured. It never touches your files.

Download Install guide

macOS 26 · Apple Silicon · Hungarian and English interface

Home: cloud cover, twilight, the pre-flight checklist, and the next thing to do, at a glance.

The whole workflow, from planning to a finished stack.

Four workspaces, one principle: every number comes from your own library. When there isn't enough data for something, the app says so instead of guessing.

703 items · indexed

Library

Reads your existing folder structure, it doesn't move or rename anything. Import goes through a verified copy, and it shows duplicates and leftover files along with their size.

culmination 88° · Moon 102°

Planning

Target suggestions by visibility, framing, and moon phase, with a season window and equipment comparison. The estimate states what it's assuming.

FWHM · background · 24/24 usable

Nights

Every night on one timeline: twilight, target, capture bands. Morning frame measurement and triage, so you filter out the weak frames before stacking.

35h 35m · 13 targets

Insights

Integration trends, filter and equipment usage, a night leaderboard, a year summary. Duplicated frames only count once.

Organizes, plans, and gives structure to your work.

Puts things in order

Builds a project, night, series, and frame-level structure out of your folders. Finds duplicates and processing leftovers, with their size. It never touches your captures.

Plans in detail

Tonight's targets by visibility, moon, and framing. Season window, cloud forecast, an integration goal and pace, for example: about 6 more clear nights to the goal.

Walks you through the night

A pre-flight checklist, a night timeline, morning measurement and triage. You filter out the weak frames before stacking.

A closer look

Every screen, from a real library, with real numbers.
